## Question

Review of orchestration-split returned NEEDS_WORK. The blocker is that phase HEAD f677417 still has the pre-split store. Landing keeps .artifacts off that branch; the split is commit 3517afd on main and the store in ~/orchestra. A second finding, marked judgment, is that AGENTS.md and README.md still describe skills and the dashboard in this repo.

Should the live stores count as the split, and should the docs change in this phase?
